name: Galvács (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Galvács: a blue shield with a yellow charge within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed GALVÁCS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Galvács arms with wreath and scroll
